trends.name: Iran Escalation & Strait of Hormuz Crisis
trends.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards threaten harder retaliation for future strikes and claim attacks on U.S.-connected steel/aluminum sites. Trump signals continued bombing, while Macron warns it's unrealistic to open Hormuz by force militarily. Geopolitical tension directly driving 10%+ oil price spikes and energy market volatility with cascading supply chain implications.

trends.name: Oil Price Surge & Energy Market Impact
trends.summary: Oil prices jumped 10% on Iran war speech and continued escalation fears, with markets pricing in potential supply disruption. Concerns about 1970s-style stagflation and demand destruction if conflict prolongs. Colonial Pipeline restart provides some relief but geopolitical uncertainty remains primary driver.

trends.name: Trump Administration Policy Contradictions
trends.summary: International leaders, including Macron, openly criticize Trump for daily contradictions on Iran policy and military responsibility. Trump calling on Japan, France, South Korea, and China to guard Hormuz while also saying bombing will continue signals confused foreign policy messaging. Market uncertainty stems from policy unpredictability affecting trade, sanctions, and geopolitical outcomes.

trends.name: Retirement & Savings Rate Concerns
trends.summary: Breaking report shows 1 in 4 workers cutting 401(k) contribution rates, signaling growing financial stress and reduced retirement savings. Combined with inflation concerns ($4 gas, rising costs), workers reassessing emergency funds and income needs. Broader indicator of consumer financial health deteriorating despite employment data.

trends.name: EV Market Dynamics & Auto Industry Pivot
trends.summary: Leapmotor delivers 100,000+ EVs for fourth straight quarter while BYD sales fall, signaling market consolidation. Paradoxically, Iran war uncertainty boosting EV demand just as auto giants pivot back to combustion engines. Mixed signals on long-term EV dominance and near-term demand drivers.

trends.name: GLP-1 Drug Competition & Obesity Market
trends.summary: Novo Nordisk claims Wegovy pill outperforms Eli Lilly's oral GLP-1 in cross-trial comparison, intensifying competition in high-growth obesity treatment market. Clinical data comparisons now driving stock valuations and market share expectations. Thorne supplement sales up to $650M on Gen Z health trends, showing broader wellness market expansion.

trends.name: Interest Rate Expectations & BOE Policy Shift
trends.summary: Bank of America Global Research revises BOE expectations from cuts to two 25bp rate hikes in June/July 2026, signaling inflation persistence in UK. Reversal from cutting scenario implies broader global interest rate environment staying elevated longer than previously expected, pressuring valuations.

trends.name: Infrastructure & Industrial Capex Surge
trends.summary: Caterpillar aggressively expanding with $3.5B capex planned for 2026 (+25% YoY) amid grid infrastructure spending and power expansion. Rising DRAM and diesel energy costs creating input inflation headwinds. Power and grid infrastructure baskets outperforming despite geopolitical concerns, suggesting long-term demand confidence.

trends.name: Income Investing & Dividend Stock Demand
trends.summary: High-yield dividend stocks gaining investor attention with 7-11% yields attracting capital in uncertain rate environment. Realty Income (Dividend Aristocrat), Chimera Investment, and Globe Life baby bonds highlighted as income plays. Reflects rotation into yield as investors seek cash flow amid market volatility.

trends.name: Tax Policy & Trump's Overtime Deduction Impact
trends.summary: Treasury confirms Trump's overtime deduction has been a 'home run' policy, benefiting working-class taxpayers. Tax policy shifts influencing consumer spending power and labor market dynamics. Broader context of reconciliation 2.0 negotiations and DHS funding fights suggest continued fiscal policy uncertainty.

trends.name: Healthcare Access & Medicare Advantage Crisis
trends.summary: Systemic issue emerging: many hospitals rejecting Medicare Advantage plans for cancer treatment, creating access gaps for seniors. Highlights tensions in healthcare system and potential regulatory flashpoint. Affects consumer healthcare costs and insurance company profitability in growing demographic segment.

trends.name: AI Investment & OpenAI Funding Round
trends.summary: ARK Invest (Cathie Wood) participates in OpenAI's latest funding round, signaling continued institutional capital flowing into AI infrastructure. Demonstrates investor confidence in AI secular growth thesis despite broader market volatility. Relevant for tech valuations and AI-adjacent stock movements.
